crm_notes: Primary ask: Private VPC deployment inside EU (GDPR + local regulators) — must demonstrate full audit trail export to customer's Splunk/Elastic stack.
Audit logging specifics requested by Verity SecOps:
- SIEM export options: syslog (TLS), HTTPS JSON-lines, Kafka topic, S3 export for long-term archival. Prefer Splunk HEC + ELK ingestion. Need cert-based mutual TLS support for forwarders.

- Log schema: structured JSON preferred. Required fields: timestamp, request_id, route, model_version, tenant_id, user_pseudonym, action_type (generate/embed), bytes_in, bytes_out, token_count, latency_ms, response_status, ip_hash, auth_method, key_id (KMS key fingerprint), audit_event_type (access, admin, system), reason_code.

- Access logs: must include admin console actions (role, actor_id), API key lifecycle events (create/revoke/rotate), and model rollout changes. Admin console UI actions must be logged with before/after snapshots where applicable.

- Retention: regulatory requirement = 7 years archival for audit trails. Proposed Redwood plan discussed: 1 year hot (searchable), 6 years cold (S3 Glacier-equivalent). Customer prefers S3 with lifecycle + object lock option for immutability.

- Privacy controls: PII must be redacted or token-hashed in logs; full replay acceptable only under KMS-unseal by customer (customer-managed keys). Need support for envelope encryption and HSM/KMS integration (bring-your-own-key, HSM-backed KMS).
- Log format governance: Verity asked for a log schema contract (JSON Schema/Avro) and example log_lines for ingestion testing — SE asked to provide within 5 business days.
- Threat model/assurance: will require SOC2 Type II report + ISO27001 cert + penetration test summary before procurement approval.
- Network controls: VPC peering / private link + firewall rules + allowed egress for SIEM forwarders. Also requested explicit IP allowlist and CIDR ranges for endpoints.
- Redwood SE to produce sample logs (10k lines) in JSON-lines and a CEF mapping table.
- Infra to document KMS integration options (Redwood-managed key, customer-managed key in HSM, external KMS via proxy).
- Security to confirm retention/immutability and provide recommended S3 lifecycle policy example and object-lock pattern.
Customer quote (paraphrase): 'We need evidence that every token and admin action can be audited and stored for regulatory review for the next 7 years — no exceptions.'
Tone: risk-averse, procurement timeline conservative. Procurement begins after security artifacts delivered.
